"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/longest-word-in-dictionary-through-deleting/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

524. Longest Word in Dictionary through Deleting

Given a string s and a string array dictionary, return the longest string in the dictionary that can be formed by deleting some of the given string characters. If there is more than one possible result, return the longest word with the smallest lexicographical order. If there is no possible result, return the empty string.

Example 1:

Input: s = "abpcplea", dictionary = ["ale","apple","monkey","plea"]
Output: "apple"

Example 2:

Input: s = "abpcplea", dictionary = ["a","b","c"]
Output: "a"

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length <= 1000
    1 <= dictionary.length <= 1000
    1 <= dictionary[i].length <= 1000
    s and dictionary[i] consist of lowercase English letters.
"""


class Solution:
    def findLongestWord(self, s: str, dictionary: List[str]) -> str:
        def is_subsequence(x: str) -> bool:
            it = 0
            for c in s:
                if it < len(x) and x[it] == c:
                    it += 1
                if it == len(x):
                    break
            return it == len(x)

        best = ""
        for word in dictionary:
            if is_subsequence(word):
                if len(word) > len(best) or (len(word) == len(best) and word < best):
                    best = word
        return best


sol = Solution()

print(sol.findLongestWord("abpcplea", ["ale", "apple", "monkey", "plea"]))  # "apple"

assert sol.findLongestWord("abpcplea", ["ale", "apple", "monkey", "plea"]) == "apple"
assert sol.findLongestWord("abpcplea", ["a", "b", "c"]) == "a"

assert sol.findLongestWord("", ["a", "b", "c"]) == ""
assert sol.findLongestWord("a", ["a", "aa", "aaa"]) == "a"
assert sol.findLongestWord("abc", ["abc", "ac", "bc", "a", "b", "c"]) == "abc"
assert sol.findLongestWord("abc", ["abcd", "abce", "abcf"]) == ""
assert sol.findLongestWord("abc", ["xyz", "def", "ghi"]) == ""
assert sol.findLongestWord("aabbcc", ["abc", "aabbcc", "abccba"]) == "aabbcc"
assert (
    sol.findLongestWord("zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba", ["a", "b", "c", "z", "yx", "wv"])
    == "wv"
)
assert sol.findLongestWord("abcde", ["edcba", "abcde", "bcdea"]) == "abcde"
assert sol.findLongestWord("abcde", ["abcde", "abcde", "abcde"]) == "abcde"
